verdict.rationale: An interactive API reference is a fair question for a SaaS development platform like LightSprint, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions an API reference, API docs, or runnable examples. Probes found no OpenAPI spec at any candidate path and no llms.txt; live previews of code changes are a different feature and do not count.
